title: United States NIST Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0 & GenAI Profile)
stage_label: NIST AI Risk Management Framework 1.0 (NIST AI 100-1)

institutional_author.name: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)

summary: Release of NIST AI RMF 1.0 defining trustworthiness characteristics (valid/reliable, safe, secure/resilient, accountable/transparent, explainable/interpretable, privacy-enhanced, fair with harmful bias managed) and the four Core Functions: GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE.
